// tenbitrefgen only creates independent native reference data for trusted
// developers. It imports no candidate decoder/converter and is never an SDK tool.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"image"
	"image/color"
	"image/png"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	encoderSHA     = "f9cd38ec2804b56174344fd178ea919f9bff41ec7fc4a471f0ff9065b1b5d076" // Reviewed libavif1.4.2/libaom3.14.1/no-libyuv reference encoder.
	decoderSHA     = "635e3acc8cc93212ca5cf1cc867b9bb6f3b738574e92107ed24be48a4a75e6bd" // Same independently reviewed native decoder as V05X.
	channelMax     = 65535                                                              // PNG source samples use all sixteen bits, never an eight-bit replicated source.
	commandTimeout = 30 * time.Second                                                   // Per trusted native fixture command; not a decoder/SDK deadline contract.
)

type entry struct {
	Name, Range, Chroma                                     string
	Width, Height                                           int
	SourcePNG, AVIF, ReferencePNG, ReferenceY4M, NearestPNG string
	EncodeArgs, DecodeArgs, PlaneArgs, NearestArgs          []string
}
type command struct {
	Tool   string
	Args   []string
	Output string
	Error  string
}
type manifest struct {
	Version                                                     int
	Go, OS, Arch, GeneratorSHA256, EncoderSHA256, DecoderSHA256 string
	NativeLibraryPins                                           map[string]string
	Files                                                       map[string]string
	Cases                                                       []entry
	Commands                                                    []command
}

func digest(b []byte) string { h := sha256.Sum256(b); return hex.EncodeToString(h[:]) }
func pattern(width, height int) *image.NRGBA64 {
	m := image.NewNRGBA64(image.Rect(0, 0, width, height))
	bars := []color.NRGBA64{{0, 0, 0, channelMax}, {channelMax, channelMax, channelMax, channelMax}, {32768, 32768, 32768, channelMax}, {channelMax, 0, 0, channelMax}, {0, channelMax, 0, channelMax}, {0, 0, channelMax, channelMax}, {channelMax, channelMax, 0, channelMax}, {channelMax, 0, channelMax, channelMax}}
	for y := range height {
		for x := range width {
			// Incommensurate integer ramps exercise low bits and wrap points;
			// top-half color bars additionally exercise clipping/saturation.
			c := color.NRGBA64{uint16((x*257 + y*131 + x*y*7 + 37) & channelMax), uint16((x*811 + y*619 + x*y*11 + 109) & channelMax), uint16((x*383 + y*997 + x*y*17 + 53) & channelMax), channelMax}
			if width >= len(bars) && y < height/2 {
				c = bars[x*len(bars)/width]
			}
			m.SetNRGBA64(x, y, c)
		}
	}
	return m
}
func generate(out string) error {
	if runtime.GOOS != "darwin" || runtime.GOARCH != "arm64" {
		return errors.New("native reference toolchain pin is darwin/arm64")
	}
	enc, e := exec.LookPath("avifenc")
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	dec, e := exec.LookPath("avifdec")
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	for path, want := range map[string]string{enc: encoderSHA, dec: decoderSHA} {
		b, e := os.ReadFile(path)
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		if digest(b) != want {
			return fmt.Errorf("reference executable changed: %s", path)
		}
	}
	pinBytes, e := os.ReadFile("tenbitprobe/testdata/reference-manifest.json")
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	var old struct {
		Libraries map[string]string `json:"native_library_pins"`
	}
	if e = json.Unmarshal(pinBytes, &old); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if len(old.Libraries) != 5 {
		return errors.New("incomplete V05X native library pins")
	}
	for path, want := range old.Libraries {
		b, e := os.ReadFile(path)
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		if digest(b) != want {
			return fmt.Errorf("reference library changed: %s", path)
		}
	}
	if _, e = os.Stat(out); !os.IsNotExist(e) {
		return errors.New("choose a new output directory; never overwrite references")
	}
	if e = os.MkdirAll(out, 0o700); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	source, e := os.ReadFile("tenbitrefgen/main.go")
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	m := manifest{Version: 1, Go: runtime.Version(), OS: runtime.GOOS, Arch: runtime.GOARCH, GeneratorSHA256: digest(source), EncoderSHA256: encoderSHA, DecoderSHA256: decoderSHA, NativeLibraryPins: old.Libraries, Files: map[string]string{}}
	save := func(name string, b []byte) error {
		if e := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, name), b, 0o600); e != nil {
			return e
		}
		m.Files[name] = digest(b)
		return nil
	}
	run := func(tool string, args []string) error {
		actualArgs := append([]string(nil), args...)
		for i, a := range actualArgs {
			if filepath.Ext(a) == ".png" || filepath.Ext(a) == ".avif" || filepath.Ext(a) == ".y4m" {
				actualArgs[i] = filepath.Join(out, a)
			}
		}
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), commandTimeout)
		defer cancel()
		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, tool, actualArgs...)
		cmd.Env = []string{"PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin", "LC_ALL=C"}
		b, e := cmd.CombinedOutput()
		c := command{Tool: filepath.Base(tool), Args: args, Output: strings.ReplaceAll(string(b), filepath.Clean(out), ".")}
		if e != nil {
			c.Error = e.Error()
		}
		m.Commands = append(m.Commands, c)
		if e != nil {
			raw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(m, "", "  ")
			_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "failed-manifest.json"), raw, 0o600)
			return fmt.Errorf("native reference: %w: %s", e, b)
		}
		if len(args) > 1 {
			last := args[len(args)-1]
			if filepath.Ext(last) == ".png" || filepath.Ext(last) == ".avif" || filepath.Ext(last) == ".y4m" {
				data, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(out, last))
				if e != nil {
					return e
				}
				m.Files[last] = digest(data)
			}
		}
		return nil
	}
	if e = run(enc, []string{"--version"}); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if e = run(dec, []string{"--version"}); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	// The eight geometries cover one-pixel axes, odd/even dimensions, thin and
	// rectangular pictures and the proposed 256-side/65536-pixel boundary.
	for _, dim := range [][2]int{{1, 1}, {1, 3}, {3, 1}, {17, 15}, {16, 16}, {255, 255}, {256, 255}, {256, 256}} {
		width, height := dim[0], dim[1]
		src := fmt.Sprintf("source-%dx%d.png", width, height)
		var buf bytes.Buffer
		if e = png.Encode(&buf, pattern(width, height)); e != nil {
			return e
		}
		if e = save(src, buf.Bytes()); e != nil {
			return e
		}
		for _, rng := range []string{"full", "limited"} {
			for _, chroma := range []string{"420", "444"} {
				name := fmt.Sprintf("rgb16-%dx%d-%s-%s", width, height, rng, chroma)
				v := entry{Name: name, Range: rng, Chroma: chroma, Width: width, Height: height, SourcePNG: src, AVIF: name + ".avif", ReferencePNG: name + "-reference.png", ReferenceY4M: name + ".y4m"}
				v.EncodeArgs = []string{"--codec", "aom", "--jobs", "1", "--depth", "10", "--yuv", chroma, "--range", rng, "--cicp", "1/13/6", "--qcolor", "100", "--speed", "6", src, v.AVIF}
				v.DecodeArgs = []string{"--codec", "aom", "--jobs", "1", "--depth", "16", "--upsampling", "bilinear", "--size-limit", "65536", "--dimension-limit", "256", v.AVIF, v.ReferencePNG}
				v.PlaneArgs = []string{"--codec", "aom", "--jobs", "1", "--size-limit", "65536", "--dimension-limit", "256", v.AVIF, v.ReferenceY4M}
				if e = run(enc, v.EncodeArgs); e != nil {
					return e
				}
				if e = run(dec, v.DecodeArgs); e != nil {
					return e
				}
				if e = run(dec, v.PlaneArgs); e != nil {
					return e
				}
				if chroma == "420" {
					v.NearestPNG = name + "-nearest.png"
					v.NearestArgs = append([]string(nil), v.DecodeArgs...)
					v.NearestArgs[7] = "nearest"
					v.NearestArgs[len(v.NearestArgs)-1] = v.NearestPNG
					if e = run(dec, v.NearestArgs); e != nil {
						return e
					}
				}
				m.Cases = append(m.Cases, v)
			}
		}
	}
	b, e := json.MarshalIndent(m, "", "  ")
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "manifest.json"), append(b, '\n'), 0o600)
}
func main() {
	out := flag.String("out", "", "new private directory for independent ten-bit reference corpus; required")
	flag.Parse()
	if *out == "" {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "-out is required")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	if e := generate(*out); e != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, e)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("Independent 10-bit source/AVIF/YUV/RGB16 corpus created; no candidate was imported or run.")
}
